mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand proxied by HOUST coincides with stronger labor market conditions (PAYEMS), leading to higher corporate earnings expectations and a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero when demand proxies are rising (Granger causality fails).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend suggests supply-side constraints that boost risk premia and drive negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns show no significant deviation from the mean during INDPRO contractions (p > 0.1 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4% triggers a flight to quality in equities, producing a positive 5-day forward return as investors anticipate slower economic growth.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative when UNRATE crosses above 4% (contrary to the hypothesis).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 2%, the S&P 500 anticipates a Fed rate hike path, resulting in negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when CPIAUCSL > 2% (inverting the expected effect).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in both demand (HOUST) and labor (PAYEMS) indicators creates a synergistic effect that drives a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are flat or negative despite rising HOUST and PAYEMS (interaction effect not significant).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in employment (PAYEMS) below 150,000 suggests a recessionary shock that reduces corporate profit margins and yields negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly different from zero during PAYEMS contractions (Granger causality holds).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS) indicates structural supply-side weakness, which amplifies equity risk premia and produces a positive 5-day forward return as investors anticipate lower growth.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative when RSAFS declines (mechanism inverts).

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed maintains FEDFUNDS near 5% for two consecutive months, it signals a higher-for-longer inflation path, which is associated with negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS stays above 5% (contrary to the expectation).
